headline: TEX @ HOU matchup research
quickWriteup: The current model score is TEX 4.25 at HOU 3.29, with a projected total of 7.54. Movement read: The side movement strengthened toward TEX: TEX moved -0.38 runs while HOU moved -1.02, changing the projected margin by +0.64 runs. The projected total fell -1.40, which points to a lower-run game script than the earliest saved read. NRFI probability rose +25.5%, so the first-inning read became more pitcher-friendly early. Pitching context: Kai-Wei Teng has the better recent run-prevention profile in the available outing logs at 1.2 ER over the last 5 outings. Batter research is strongest for Braden Shewmake, Ezequiel Duran, Jose Altuve, based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production. The cold/risk list flags Corey Seager, Cam Smith because the recent hit profile or strikeout trend is weaker than the projection alone would show.
